about: A modelled estimate built from public weather data. Not an official snow report, not avalanche advice, not affiliated with Vail Resorts.

days.label: Feb 7, 2020: the deep day
days.conditions: Snowing hard: about 1 in an hour at mid-mountain, 21.5 in new in the last 24 hours, medium-weight. Untracked snow is still easy to find in the open, about 12 in. Windy on the ridges, WNW 26 mph.

days.label: Jan 31, 2014: 19 inches overnight
days.conditions: 21 in of new snow in the last 24 hours, medium-weight, and it has stopped. Untracked snow is still easy to find in the open, about 8.5 in.
days.note: Before the HRRR archive begins: rebuilt from the gauge and ERA5 only, so wind and cloud are coarse.

days.label: Mar 4, 2019: bluebird after the storm
days.conditions: 11 in of new snow in the last 24 hours, dense, and it has stopped. Untracked snow is still easy to find in the open, about 3.5 in.

days.label: Jan 31, 2024: two weeks without snow
days.conditions: No new snow for 14 days. Fresh snow is used up: groomed corduroy and packed snow everywhere. A crust has formed on sun-exposed slopes.

days.label: Dec 22, 2022: the arctic front, ridge-top gale
days.conditions: 7.5 in of new snow in the last 24 hours, medium-weight, and it has stopped. The open runs are skied off; the best leftovers are in the trees in Northwoods, about 9.5 in. Windy on the ridges, W 36 mph.
